RequiresComparableUnitTokens.documentation: Guarded APIs only accept unit token pairs that can be compared with one another. For example, comparisons where either unit is 'player' or 'target' are permitted, but comparisons between 'nameplate3' and 'boss1' are not.

RequiresDeclassifiedUnitIdentity.documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to the identity of a supplied unit token.

RequiresFontStringTextAccess.documentation: Guarded APIs reject access for tainted callers if the object has the secret Text aspect assigned.

RequiresUnitIdentityAccess.documentation: Guarded APIs and events require that callers have access to unit identity values. This does not raise a blocked action error - instead, protected APIs will return no values.

SecretInActivePvPMatch.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when PvP match addon restrictions are in effect.

SecretInChatMessagingLockdown.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect, and when the player is on a communication-restricted map such as a dungeon or raid.

SecretOnRestrictedMaps.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the player is on an addon-restricted map such as a dungeon or raid.

SecretWhenAnchoringSecret.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when an object has secret anchoring information.

SecretWhenUnitAuraRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.

SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.

SecretWhenInCombat.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat addon restrictions are in effect.

SecretWhenLossOfControlInfoRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values if the subject unit is not the active player, unless they are an active spectator or commentator of a PvP match.

SecretWhenTotemSlotSecret.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when combat, encounter, challenge mode, or PvP match addon restrictions are in effect. Individual totem spell auras may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority over restrictions.

SecretWhenUnitSpellCastRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values if the unit being queried for cast information is not the player or their pet. Individual spells may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority.

SecretWhenUnitComparisonRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Comparisons involving compound unit tokens (eg. 'boss1target') are always secret. This restriction only applies when the player is on an addon-restricted map.

SecretWhenUnitHealthMaxRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled.

SecretWhenUnitIdentityRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled or in the party/raid. For compound tokens (eg. 'boss1target'), results are secret if any unit in the chain fails this.

SecretWhenUnitPowerMaxRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when the unit isn't player-controlled. Individual power types may be flagged as never or always secret, which takes priority.

SecretWhenUnitPowerRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values for power types not explicitly flagged as being never secret, unless the subject unit does not have a power of this type.

SecretWhenUnitStatsRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values when access to unit auras would generally produce secret values.

SecretWhenUnitThreatStateRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Queries where only one unit token is specified, or where one unit token is the player, their pet, or an ally while the other is a nameplate, boss, target, etc., are generally not secret.

SecretWhenUnitThreatValuesRestricted.documentation: Guarded APIs and events produce secret values based upon supplied unit tokens. Queries where only one unit token is specified, or where one unit token is the player, their pet, or an ally while the other is a non-boss or nameplate target, are generally not secret.

entries.documentation: Configures the minimum number of seconds between automatic text updates. A value of zero updates every game tick.

entries.name: SetZeroDurationText
entries.documentation: Configures the text shown when the duration is not configured, or represents a zero-duration time span.

entries.name: UpdateFontString
entries.documentation: Immediately updates the configured font string from the current duration state.

entries.name: DurationTextBindingFormatComponent
entries.documentation: The duration property sampled for this format component.

entries.name: CreateDuration
entries.documentation: Creates a zero duration container that can represent a time span.

entries.name: CreateDurationTextBinding
entries.documentation: Creates a duration text binding, which automatically updates a font string with formatted text derived from a duration object.

entries.name: CreateManualClock
entries.documentation: Creates a manually driven time source for use with duration objects.

entries.name: IsDyeColorOwned
entries.documentation: True if the player owns any of the consumable item used to apply the specified dye

entries.name: DyeColorDisplayInfo
entries.documentation: The consumable item used to apply this Dye Color; May be nil if dye color does not have an associated item

entries.name: Base64Variant
entries.documentation: Encodes with the alphabet defined in RFC 4648 (with potential padding bytes)

entries.name: CBORSerializationOptions
entries.documentation: If true, attempt to ignore errors from unsupported values and instead replace them where applicable with 'undefined' CBOR items.

entries.name: JSONSerializationOptions
entries.documentation: If true, attempt to ignore errors from unsupported values and instead replace them where applicable with 'null' JSON values.

entries.name: GetEventColor
entries.documentation: Returns any custom color override applied for an encounter event.

entries.name: GetEventInfo
entries.documentation: Returns information about an encounter event.

entries.name: GetEventList
entries.documentation: Returns a list of all encounter event IDs.

entries.name: GetEventSound
entries.documentation: Returns information on a custom sound file to be played when an encounter event trigger occurs.

entries.name: HasEventInfo
entries.documentation: Returns true if an encounter event record with a specified ID exists.

entries.name: PlayEventSound
entries.documentation: Plays any registered custom sound file for a given encounter event trigger.

entries.name: SetEventColor
entries.documentation: Sets a custom color override for an encounter event. This can be used to colorize text or timer bars individually.

entries.name: SetEventSound
entries.documentation: Sets a custom sound file to be played when an encounter event trigger occurs.

entries.name: EncounterEventColorTrigger
entries.documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event shown as a text warning alert.

entries.name: EncounterEventSoundTrigger
entries.documentation: Trigger to be activated when an text warning is initially shown for an encounter event.

entries.name: EncounterEventInfo
entries.documentation: ID of the encounter event record.

entries.name: EncounterEventSoundInfo
entries.documentation: Sound file to be played when triggered.

entries.name: EncounterEnd
entries.documentation: List of all boss units engaged during this encounter.

entries.name: GetInstanceForGameMap
entries.documentation: GameMap as opposed to UIMap since we use a mapID not a uiMapID.

entries.name: GetSectionIconFlags
entries.documentation: Represents the icon indices for this EJ section.  An icon index can be used to arrive at texture coordinates for specific encounter types, e.g.: EncounterJournal_SetFlagIcon

entries.name: ShowJourneysUI
entries.documentation: Signaled when the UI needs to display the journeys dashboard at a specific faction.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventSortDirection
entries.documentation: Events are sorted in descending order (longest time remaining to shortest).

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventSource
entries.documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event sources.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventState
entries.documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline event states.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineTrack
entries.documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline tracks., Tracks are not permitted to overlap (but may have a zero duration span), and are contiguously ordered from shortest maximum duration to longest.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineTrackType
entries.documentation: Enumeration of all encounter timeline track types. Track types infer behavioral aspects of the track, for example whether or not we associate sort orders to events in the track.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineViewType
entries.documentation: Enumeration of view types for the timeline., View types control layout parameters for the timeline such as maximum track durations and event counts, and optimize event processing for expected display behaviors.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventConstants
entries.documentation: Constant used for invalid event IDs. Script APIs are guaranteed to always return nil data if supplied this ID, and events will never be added to the timeline with this ID.

entries.name: AddEditModeEvents
entries.documentation: Adds a predefined set of events to the timeline for display in Edit Mode.

entries.name: AddScriptEvent
entries.documentation: Adds a custom event to the timeline.

entries.name: CancelAllScriptEvents
entries.documentation: Cancels all custom timeline events, removing them from the timeline.

entries.name: CancelEditModeEvents
entries.documentation: Removes all Edit Mode events from the timeline.

entries.name: CancelScriptEvent
entries.documentation: Cancels a custom timeline event, removing it from the timeline.

entries.name: FinishScriptEvent
entries.documentation: Finishes a custom timeline event, removing it from the timeline.

entries.name: GetCurrentTime
entries.documentation: Returns the current timestamp used for rendering the timeline display.

entries.name: GetEventColor
entries.documentation: Returns the current color used to render timeline event.

entries.name: GetEventCountBySource
entries.documentation: Returns the number of present events in the timeline by their source type.

entries.name: GetEventHighlightTime
entries.documentation: Returns the duration at which timeline events will be highlighted for imminency.

entries.name: GetEventInfo
entries.documentation: Returns information about a timeline event. This data is generally expected to be static for the lifetime of an event.

entries.name: GetEventList
entries.documentation: Returns an unsorted list of event IDs present in the timeline.

entries.name: GetEventState
entries.documentation: Returns the current state of a timeline event.

entries.name: GetEventTimeElapsed
entries.documentation: Returns the elapsed duration of a timeline event.

entries.name: GetEventTimeRemaining
entries.documentation: Returns the remaining duration of a timeline event.

entries.name: GetEventTimer
entries.documentation: Returns a Duration object that tracks the elapsed duration of a timeline event. This object tracks the range [0, duration] of the event and automatically pauses its progression based on event state.

entries.name: GetEventTrack
entries.documentation: Returns information about the position of an event on the timeline.

entries.name: GetSortedEventList
entries.documentation: Returns a sorted list of event IDs present in the timeline from shortest to longest remaining durations, meeting the requirements of the specified filters.

entries.name: GetTrackInfo
entries.documentation: Returns information for a single timeline track.

entries.name: GetTrackList
entries.documentation: Returns information about all timeline tracks.

entries.name: GetTrackMaxEventDuration
entries.documentation: Returns the maximum permitted event duration on a single timeline track.

entries.name: GetTrackType
entries.documentation: Returns the type of a single timeline track.

entries.name: GetViewType
entries.documentation: Returns the current view type of the timeline.

entries.name: HasActiveEvents
entries.documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events in the active state.

entries.name: HasAnyEvents
entries.documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events in any state.

entries.name: HasPausedEvents
entries.documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events in the paused state.

entries.name: HasVisibleEvents
entries.documentation: Returns true if the timeline contains any events that are on visible tracks.

entries.name: IsEventBlocked
entries.documentation: Returns true if the event is in a 'blocked' state, where the cast for this event may not occur due to encounter conditions not being met.

entries.name: IsFeatureAvailable
entries.documentation: Returns true if the encounter timeline feature is available on this client.

entries.name: IsFeatureEnabled
entries.documentation: Returns true if the encounter timeline feature has been enabled by the player. This function will always return false if the feature is not available.

entries.name: PauseScriptEvent
entries.documentation: Pauses a custom timeline event, hiding it from the timeline. A paused event can later be resumed to show it again, or canceled.

entries.name: ResumeScriptEvent
entries.documentation: Resumes a custom timeline event, showing it on the timeline again if it is currently paused.

entries.name: SetEventIconTextures
entries.documentation: Updates a given vector of texture objects to reference art assets for icons associated with an event.

entries.name: SetViewType
entries.documentation: Changes the view type for the timeline. This adjusts track layouts to be more appropriate for a specific mode and optimizes event processing.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventAdded
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has been added to the timeline.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventBlockStateChanged
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has transitioned into or out of a 'blocked' status.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventColorChanged
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has met a condition that should trigger a color change.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventHighlight
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has met a condition that should trigger its highlight glow animation.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventRemoved
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has been removed from the timeline. This is guaranteed to fire after an event has transitioned to a 'final' state such as Canceled or Finished, and will be delayed at least one game tick to allow for API queries to still access event data in OnUpdate scripts. This is fired post-removal of the event, and so queries using the supplied event ID will return nil.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventStateChanged
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has changed state.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventTrackChanged
entries.documentation: Fired when an event has changed track, or has been re-ordered within its existing track.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineLayoutUpdated
entries.documentation: Fired when the layout of tracks on the timeline has been updated. This can include changes to the minimum or maximum durations of tracks.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineStateUpdated
entries.documentation: Signaled when conditions controlling the visibility of the encounter timeline are updated.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineViewActivated
entries.documentation: Fired when a new timeline view is being activated. This is fired after a full layout and timeline data update, allowing the UI to immediately query the API and get usable results.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineViewDeactivated
entries.documentation: Fired when the current timeline view is being deactivated. The UI should clear all stored timeline event data and release all frames back to pools during this event.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventFilter
entries.documentation: Maximum number of sorted events to return.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineEventInfo
entries.documentation: Instance ID for this event.

entries.name: EncounterTimelineTrackInfo
entries.documentation: The exclusive lower bound of durations for events on this track. If zero, this should be treated as an inclusive lower bound. This bound is ignored by the timeline sequence in circumstances where an adjacent Sorted track would exceed its maximum event count, requiring events be pushed 'to the left' by one track.

entries.name: GetPlayCustomSoundsWhenHidden
entries.documentation: Returns true if custom sound alerts are allowed to play for hidden warning messages.

entries.name: GetWarningsShown
entries.documentation: Returns true if text messages for encounter events are allowed to be shown.

entries.name: SetPlayCustomSoundsWhenHidden
entries.documentation: Controls whether custom sound alerts for encounter events are allowed to play for warning messages that are hidden.

entries.name: SetWarningsShown
entries.documentation: Controls whether text messages for encounter events are allowed to be shown.

entries.name: CanShowEvents
entries.documentation: Returns true if there are any events eligible to show for the player.

entries.name: ClearReminder
entries.documentation: Clears reminder on a scheduled event. Must use endTime to identify which specific instance in the case of repeating ones.

entries.name: GetActiveContinentName
entries.documentation: Returns the name of the continent with current events

entries.name: GetEventUiMapID
entries.documentation: Will try to figure out a UiMap for an areaPOI.

entries.name: GetEventZoneName
entries.documentation: Will try to figure out a map zone name for an areaPOI

entries.name: GetOngoingEvents
entries.documentation: Will request data from the server on a throttle

entries.name: GetScheduledEvents
entries.documentation: Will request data from the server on a throttle

entries.name: HasData
entries.documentation: True if the server sent a list, even if the list had 0 events.

entries.name: HasSavedReminders
entries.documentation: Returns whether there are any event reminders saved. Can include reminders that have expired since set and haven't gotten removed yet. Has to be called after cvars are loaded.

entries.name: RequestEvents
entries.documentation: Requests events from the server, subject to throttle

entries.name: SetReminder
entries.documentation: Sets reminder on a scheduled event. Must use endTime to identify which specific instance in the case of repeating ones.

entries.name: GetMaxLevelForExpansionLevel
entries.documentation: Maps an expansion level to a maximum character level for that expansion.

entries.name: GetCooldownDisplayDuration
entries.documentation: The returned duration unit is milliseconds, unaffected by modRate.

entries.name: GetCooldownDuration
entries.documentation: The returned duration unit is milliseconds and is multiplied by the modRate.

entries.name: GetCountdownAbbrevThreshold
entries.documentation: Returns the threshold below which cooldown numbers are displayed as an abbreviated form without a unit suffix (eg. '1:31').

entries.name: GetCountdownMillisecondsThreshold
entries.documentation: Returns the threshold below which cooldown numbers are displayed as a decimal value with one place for milliseconds (eg. '8.7').

entries.name: SetCountdownAbbrevThreshold
entries.documentation: Sets the threshold below which cooldown numbers are displayed as an abbreviated form without a unit suffix (eg. '1:31').

entries.name: SetCountdownMillisecondsThreshold
entries.documentation: Sets the threshold below which cooldown numbers are displayed as a decimal value with one place for milliseconds (eg. '8.7').

entries.name: SetMinimumCountdownDuration
entries.documentation: Controls the minimum duration above which countdown text will be shown. This is applied based upon the total duration of the cooldown, not the remaining duration as it ticks down.

entries.name: SetUseAuraDisplayTime
entries.documentation: Aura durations are displayed slightly differently than cooldown durations. Setting this to true will adjust the display logic to stay in sync with aura timers.

entries.name: SetPreferModelCollisionBounds
entries.documentation: If true, will try to use the collision bounds of models for sizing and centering. Will fall back to default model bounds if set to False, or if collision bounds are unavailable.

entries.name: GetCameraFieldOfView
entries.documentation: Field of view in radians

entries.name: SetCameraFieldOfView
entries.documentation: Field of view in radians

entries.name: CanChangeHitTestPoints
entries.documentation: Returns true if this nameplate permits changes to its hit-test points. Updates are normally blocked for tainted code during combat, except on the tick a unit is first assigned or when untainted code updates hit-test points on the same tick.

entries.name: ClearAllHitTestPoints
entries.documentation: Clears the anchor points that determine where the mouse interacts with the nameplate.

entries.name: GetHitTestPoints
entries.documentation: Returns the anchor points that determine where the mouse interacts with the nameplate.

entries.name: SetAllHitTestPoints
entries.documentation: Sets the anchor points that determine where the mouse interacts with the nameplate to fully encompass the target region.

entries.name: SetHitTestPoints
entries.documentation: Sets the anchor points that determine where the mouse interacts with the nameplate.

entries.name: RequiresCanChangeHitTestPoints
entries.documentation: Guarded APIs require that the nameplate frame must allow changes to its hit test points.

entries.name: ClearPadding
entries.documentation: Set all padding values to 0.0 and remove the Padding SecretAspect.

entries.name: canaccessallvalues
entries.documentation: Returns true if the immediate calling function has appropriate permissions to access and operate on all supplied values.

entries.name: canaccesssecrets
entries.documentation: Returns true if the immediate calling function has appropriate permissions to access or operate on secret values.

entries.name: canaccesstable
entries.documentation: Returns true if the immediate calling function has appropriate permissions to index secret tables. This will return false if the caller cannot access the table value itself, or if access to the table contents is disallowed by taint.

entries.name: canaccessvalue
entries.documentation: Returns true if the immediate calling function has appropriate permissions to access and operate on a specific value.

entries.name: dropsecretaccess
entries.documentation: Removes the ability for the immediate calling function to access secret values.

entries.name: dumpobject
entries.documentation: Invokes the '__dump' metamethod on any value (if present), returning its result.

entries.name: hasanysecretvalues
entries.documentation: Returns true if a supplied value is a secret value.

entries.name: issecrettable
entries.documentation: Returns true if a supplied value is a secret table. This function will return true if the table value itself is secret, or if flags on the table are set such that accesses of the table would produce secrets.

entries.name: issecretvalue
entries.documentation: Returns true if a supplied value is a secret value.

entries.name: mapvalues
entries.documentation: Applies a given function over all supplied values individually, replacing the value with the result of the call.

entries.name: scrubsecretvalues
entries.documentation: Returns a transformed list of values with inputs that are secret values replaced by nil values.

entries.name: scrub
entries.documentation: Returns a transformed list of values with inputs that are either secret or are not string, number, or boolean type replaced by nil values.

entries.name: secretunwrap
entries.documentation: Unwraps all supplied secrets, converting them back to regular values.

entries.name: secretwrap
entries.documentation: Converts all supplied values to secret values, preventing most operations on them from occurring on tainted code paths.

entries.name: securecallmethod
entries.documentation: Invokes a named method on an object with a secure call barrier that prevents errors or taint from function lookup and execution from propagating to the caller.

entries.name: debugprofilestart
entries.documentation: Starts a timer for profiling. The final time can be obtained by calling debugprofilestop.

entries.name: debugprofilestop
entries.documentation: Returns the time in milliseconds since the last debugprofilestart call.

entries.name: GetGameRuleAsFloat
entries.documentation: Returns the numeric value specified in the Game Rule, multiplied by 0.1 for every decimal place requested

entries.name: GetGameRuleAsFrameStrata
entries.documentation: Returns the value specified in the Game Rule converted to a frame strata

entries.name: IsPersonalResourceDisplayEnabled
entries.documentation: Checks the game rule as well as nameplateShowSelf

entries.name: ActivateHouseEditorMode
entries.documentation: Attempts switch the House Editor to a specific House Editor mode

entries.name: EnterHouseEditor
entries.documentation: Attempts to open the House Editor to the default House Editor mode

entries.name: GetHouseEditorAvailability
entries.documentation: Returns the availability state of the House Editor overall

entries.name: GetHouseEditorModeAvailability
entries.documentation: Returns the availability of a specific House Editor mode

entries.name: IsHouseEditorActive
entries.documentation: Returns whether the House Editor is active, in any mode

entries.name: IsHouseEditorModeActive
entries.documentation: Returns whether the specific House Editor mode is active

entries.name: IsHouseEditorStatusAvailable
entries.documentation: Returns true if the HouseEditor currently able process mode availability and switching; May be false if not in a house or plot, or while waiting to get house settings back from the server

entries.name: HousingCoreFixtureInfo
entries.documentation: For fixtures that are variants, the id of specific selected variant; If fixture has no variants, will be the same id as selectedStyleFixtureID

entries.name: CancelActiveExteriorEditing
entries.documentation: Cancels all in-progress editing of house exterior fixtures, which will deselect any active targets

entries.name: IsAnyDecorAttachedToCoreFixture
entries.documentation: Returns true if any decor is attached to the specified core fixture type, OR any child fixtures attached to it; Will also return false if the type provided is not a core fixture type, or if not in Exterior Customization mode on an owned plot

entries.name: IsAnyDecorAttachedToDoor
entries.documentation: Returns true if any decor is attached to the current House Exterior's door; Will also return false if not in Exterior Customization mode on an owned plot

entries.name: IsAnyDecorAttachedToHouseExterior
entries.documentation: Returns true if any decor is attached to any component of the current House Exterior; Will also return false if not in House Exterior Customization mode on an owned Plot

entries.name: IsAnyDecorAttachedToSelectedFixturePoint
entries.documentation: Returns true if any decor is attached to the Fixture occupying the currently selected fixture point; Will also return false if no point is currently selected, or if there is currently no Fixture there

entries.name: RemoveFixtureFromSelectedPoint
entries.documentation: What to do with any decor currently attached to the fixture

entries.name: SelectCoreFixtureOption
entries.documentation: What to do with any decor attached to the old core fixture; If the fixture being swapped is a variant (ie recolor) of the existing one, attached decor will always be reparented directly to the new one

entries.name: SelectFixtureOption
entries.documentation: If this fixture choice is replacing an existing one that has decor attached, what to do with any decor attached to the old one

entries.name: SetHouseExteriorSize
entries.documentation: What to do with decor attached to any of the house's existing exterior components

entries.name: SetHouseExteriorType
entries.documentation: What to do with decor attached to any of the house's existing exterior components

entries.name: CancelActiveEditing
entries.documentation: Cancels all in-progress editing of the selected target, which will reset any unsaved changes and deselect the active target; Un-placed decor will be returned to the house chest

entries.name: CommitDecorMovement
entries.documentation: Attempt to save the changes made to the currently selected decor instance

entries.name: CommitHouseExteriorPosition
entries.documentation: Attempt to save the changes made to the House Exterior's position within the plot

entries.name: GetHoveredDecorInfo
entries.documentation: Returns info for the placed decor instance currently being hovered, if there is one

entries.name: GetSelectedDecorInfo
entries.documentation: Returns info for the decor instance that's currently selected, if there is one

entries.name: IsDecorSelected
entries.documentation: Returns true if a decor instance is currently selected and being dragged

entries.name: IsFreePlaceEnabled
entries.documentation: When free place is enabled, collision checks while dragging decor/the house exterior are ignored

entries.name: IsHouseExteriorHovered
entries.documentation: Returns true if the house's exterior is currently being hovered

entries.name: IsHouseExteriorSelected
entries.documentation: Returns true if the house's exterior is currently selected and being moved

entries.name: IsHoveringDecor
entries.documentation: Returns true if a placed decor instance is currently being hovered

entries.name: RemoveSelectedDecor
entries.documentation: Attempt to return the currently selected decor instance back to the house chest

entries.name: RotateDecor
entries.documentation: Rotates the currently selected decor along a single axis; For wall decor, rotates such that the object stays flat against its current wall; For all other decor, rotates around the Z (vertical) axis

entries.name: RotateHouseExterior
entries.documentation: Rotates the House Exterior around the Z (vertical) axis

entries.name: SetFreePlaceEnabled
entries.documentation: Set whether free place is enabled; When free place is enabled, collision checks while dragging decor/the house exterior are ignored

entries.name: HousingCatalogEntryID
entries.documentation: Identifier for base entries in the catalog

entries.name: HousingCatalogEntryVariantID
entries.documentation: Compound Identifier for entry variant stacks in the catalog

entries.name: GetAllSearchItems
entries.documentation: Returns all catalog entries being searched (note these are NOT search results, this is the source collection of what's being searched)

entries.name: GetCatalogSearchResults
entries.documentation: Returns the most recent search result entries

entries.name: GetNumSearchItems
entries.documentation: Returns the total number of entries being searched through

entries.name: GetSearchCount
entries.documentation: Returns the total number of owned instances across all most recent search result entries

entries.name: RunSearch
entries.documentation: Run search with all current param values

entries.name: SetAllInFilterTagGroup
entries.documentation: Set the toggle state of all filter tags within a specific group; If active, only entries that match Any of the tags in the group will be included in search results

entries.name: SetAllowedIndoors
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, entries that can be placed in house interiors will be included in the search; Note many decor objects can be placed both indoors and outdoors, so having only this toggled on may still include decor that can also be placed outdoors

entries.name: SetAllowedOutdoors
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, entries that can be placed outside in plots will be included in the search; Note many decor objects can be placed both indoors and outdoors, so having only this toggled on may still include decor that can also be placed indoors

entries.name: SetAutoUpdateOnParamChanges
entries.documentation: If true, searcher automatically updates results whenever search param values are changed

entries.name: SetBaseVariantOnly
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, only the base variant of each decor entry will be included

entries.name: SetCollected
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, includes all owned entries, including those that are in storage OR placed in an owned house or plot; See IsStoredOnlyActive for a more exclusive toggle

entries.name: SetCustomizableOnly
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, catalog entries that cannot be customized (ie dyed) will be excluded from the search

entries.name: SetEditorModeContext
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If set, limits search results to only entries that are used/valid in the specified editor mode

entries.name: SetFilterTagStatus
entries.documentation: Set the toggle state of a single filter tag within a specific group

entries.name: SetFilteredCategoryID
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If set, limits search results to only those within the specified category

entries.name: SetFilteredSubcategoryID
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If set, limits search results to only those within the specified subcategory

entries.name: SetFirstAcquisitionBonusOnly
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, excludes any entries that do not reward house xp when acquired for the first time

entries.name: SetSearchText
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If set, multiple text fields are checked for instances of the text, including name, category, subcategory, and data tags

entries.name: SetStoredOnly
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, only entries that you have instances of available in storage will be included; This does not include entries that you own but have all been placed in a house; See IsCollectedActive for param that includes placed entries

entries.name: SetUncollected
entries.documentation: Search parameter; If true, includes entries that are not owned, meaning not available in storage nor placed in any owned houses or plots

entries.name: CreateCatalogSearcher
entries.documentation: Creates a new instance of a HousingCatalog searcher; This can be used to asynchronously search/filter the HousingCatalog without affecting/being restricted by the filter state of other Housing Catalog UI displays

entries.name: DestroyEntry
entries.documentation: Attempt to delete the entry from storage

entries.name: GetAllVariantInfosForEntry
entries.documentation: Returns variant info for all variants of a given catalog entry; Variants represent different visual modifications of the same base entry (ex: dyed versions)

entries.name: GetCatalogCategoryAndSubcategoryNames
entries.documentation: If found, returns the names of the parent category and the specified subcategory

entries.name: GetCatalogEntryInfoByItem
entries.documentation: ItemID, name, or link of an item that grants/corresponds to a particular type of housing catalog object (ex: decor)

entries.name: GetDecorMaxOwnedCount
entries.documentation: Returns the maximum total number of decor that can be in storage/in the house chest; Note that not all decor entries in storage count towards this limit (see GetDecorTotalOwnedCount)

entries.name: GetDecorTotalOwnedCount
entries.documentation: The total number of owned decor in storage, including both exempt and non-exempt decor

entries.name: GetDestroyableInstanceCount
entries.documentation: Returns the number of instances that can be to be destroyed in storage; These instances count towards the max storage limit

entries.name: GetMarketInfoForDecor
entries.documentation: Returns market info for a specific decor. This is decor-only for now but should be extended to support entry type and recordID generically

entries.name: HousingBundleInfo
entries.documentation: Bundles containing non-decor items cannot be previewed

entries.name: HousingCatalogCategoryInfo
entries.documentation: True if the player owns anything that falls under this category

entries.name: HousingCatalogEntryInfo
entries.documentation: Base information about an object in the Catalog; For info for a specific owned stack of this object, see HousingCatalogEntryVariantInfo

entries.name: HousingCatalogEntryVariantInfo
entries.documentation: Represents a single stack of instances of an object in the Catalog, that are all of a specific variation; For example, a stack of undyed chairs, or blue-dyed tables

entries.name: HousingCatalogSubcategoryInfo
entries.documentation: True if the player owns anything that falls under this subcategory

entries.name: HousingCategorySearchInfo
entries.documentation: If true, search will only return categories/subcategories that the player has something stored under

entries.documentation: If a dyeable decor is selected, applies a specific dye color in a specific slot as a preview; See CommitDyesForSelectedDecor to actually save applied dye changes

entries.name: ApplyThemeToRoom
entries.documentation: Attempt to apply a specific theme set (aka style) to all applicable room components in the current room

entries.name: ApplyThemeToSelectedRoomComponent
entries.documentation: Attempt to apply a specific theme set (aka style) to the currently selected room component only

entries.name: ApplyWallpaperToAllWalls
entries.documentation: Attempt to apply a specific wallpaper (aka material/texture) to all applicable room components in the current room

entries.name: ApplyWallpaperToSelectedRoomComponent
entries.documentation: Attempt to apply a specific wallpaper (aka material/texture) to the currently selected room component only

entries.name: CancelActiveEditing
entries.documentation: Cancels all in-progress editing of the selected target, which will reset any unapplied customization changes and deselect the active target

entries.name: ClearDyesForSelectedDecor
entries.documentation: Clears all previewed dye changes on the selected decor; Does not clear any already saved dyes that were previously applied

entries.name: ClearTargetRoomComponent
entries.documentation: Deselect the currently selected room component, if there is one

entries.name: CommitDyesForSelectedDecor
entries.documentation: Attempt to save all previewed dye changes made to the selected decor

entries.name: GetHoveredDecorInfo
entries.documentation: Returns info for the placed decor instance currently being hovered, if there is one

entries.name: GetHoveredRoomComponentInfo
entries.documentation: Returns info for the room component currently being hovered, if there is one

entries.name: GetNumDyesToRemoveOnSelectedDecor
entries.documentation: If a dyeable decor instance is selected, returns how many dye slots would be cleared on applying all currently previewed dye changes

entries.name: GetNumDyesToSpendOnSelectedDecor
entries.documentation: If a dyeable decor instance is selected, returns how many dye items would be spent on applying all currently previewed dye changes

entries.name: GetPreviewDyesOnSelectedDecor
entries.documentation: If a dyeable decor instance is selected, returns info structs for each new/changed dye currently being previewed

entries.name: GetRecentlyUsedDyes

entries.name: SecretWhenCooldownsRestricted

entries.name: SecretWhenUnitStatsRestricted

entries.name: SecretWhenUnitThreatStateRestricted

entries.name: SecretWhenUnitThreatValuesRestricted

entries.documentation: Toggles whether spell's autoCast is enabled

entries.name: SpellRangeCheckUpdate
entries.documentation: Used in conjunction with EnableSpellRangeCheck to inform the UI when a spell goes in or out of range with the current target.

entries.name: SpellInfo
entries.documentation: Icon for this spell; If spell has been overriden, this may be the icon for the overriding spell; See originalIconID for spell's non-overriden icon

entries.name: SpellChargeInfo
entries.documentation: Number of charges currently available

entries.name: SpellCooldownInfo
entries.documentation: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown; Current time if isEnabled is false

entries.name: SpellLossOfControlInfo
entries.documentation: If cooldown is active, time started; 0 if no cooldown

entries.name: SpellPowerCostInfo
entries.documentation: The name or 'power token' for this power type (ex: MANA, FOCUS, etc)

entries.name: CreateAbbreviatedNumberFormatter
entries.documentation: Creates a numeric formatter that converts numbers to abbreviated strings, eg. 123456 -> '123k'.

entries.name: CreateNumericRuleFormatter
entries.documentation: Creates a numeric formatter that converts numbers to strings with flexible rulesets.

entries.name: CreateSecondsFormatter
entries.documentation: Creates a numeric formatter that converts numbers measuring durations in seconds to strings, eg. 93 -> '1m 33s'.

entries.name: EscapeDecimalNonPrintables
entries.documentation:
Returns a string with ASCII control characters (except \
, \r, and 	) and invalid UTF-8 bytes replaced by decimal escape sequences (e.g. \\127).

entries.name: EscapeLuaFormatString
entries.documentation: Returns a string with Lua format string tokens ('%') escaped.

entries.name: EscapeLuaPatterns
entries.documentation: Returns a string with all Lua pattern characters escaped.

entries.name: EscapeQuotedCodes
entries.documentation: Returns a string with all quoted code sequences ('|' characters) escaped.

entries.name: RemoveContiguousSpaces
entries.documentation: Returns a string with all contiguous occurrences of ASCII space characters truncated.

entries.name: StripHyperlinks
entries.documentation: If true, preserve all '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences.

entries.name: trim
entries.documentation: Returns a string with all bytes in the 'characters' set removed from the start and end.

entries.name: TruncateWhenZero
entries.documentation: Formats the given number to a string as an integer (rounding down). If the integer is zero, returns an empty string.

entries.name: WrapString
entries.documentation: Returns a string with 'prefix' and 'suffix' joined to 'infix' iif 'infix' is not an empty string. Else, an empty string is returned.

entries.name: StripHyperlinkOptions
entries.documentation: If true, preserve all '|c' and '|r' quoted code sequences.

entries.name: GetAllTaxiNodes
entries.documentation: Returns information on taxi nodes at the current flight master.

entries.name: GetTaxiNodesForMap
entries.documentation: Returns information on taxi nodes for a given map, without considering the current flight master.

entries.name: GetItemComparisonDelta
entries.documentation: Whether the paired item's stats are added or subtracted

entries.name: GetUnitAuraByAuraInstanceID
entries.documentation: Obtains aura info like other functions with the caveat that the filters will always at least include the typically mutually exclusive HELPFUL|HARMFUL regardless of what the argument value is set to

entries.name: TooltipDataUpdate
entries.documentation: Sends an update to the UI that a sparse or cache lookup has resolved

entries.name: AddTradeMoney
entries.documentation: Adds any cursor-held money to the current trade offer.

entries.name: SetTradeMoney
entries.documentation: Sets the amount of money in the current trade offer.

entries.name: TransmogCategoryAppearanceInfo
entries.documentation: For internal testing only

entries.name: GetOutfitInfoByName
entries.documentation: Case-insensitive outfit name to search for. If multiple exist with the same name, it is unspecified which outfit will be returned.

entries.name: GetFileID
entries.documentation: Returns the numeric file ID associated with a file asset.

entries.name: IsKnownFile
entries.documentation: Determines whether a file asset is known to the client, either as a shipped asset or a locally existing loose file.

entries.name: IsLooseFile
entries.documentation: Determines whether a file asset refers to a known loose (local) file.

entries.name: DoesAnyDisplayHaveNotch
entries.documentation: True if any display attached has a notch. This does not mean the current view intersects the notch.

entries.name: GetTopLeftNotchSafeRegion
entries.documentation: Region of screen left of screen notch. Zeros if no notch.

entries.name: GetTopRightNotchSafeRegion
entries.documentation: Region of screen right of screen notch. Zeros if no notch.

entries.name: ShouldUIParentAvoidNotch
entries.documentation: UIParent will shift down to avoid notch if true. This does not mean there is a notch.

entries.name: AddActiveModelScene
entries.documentation: This function does nothing in public clients

entries.name: AddActiveModelSceneActor
entries.documentation: This function does nothing in public clients

entries.name: ClearActiveModelScene
entries.documentation: This function does nothing in public clients

entries.name: ClearActiveModelSceneActor
entries.documentation: This function does nothing in public clients

entries.name: FontStringScaleAnimationMode
entries.documentation: Scale animations apply to the height of the font. This will cause small jumps between different font heights as the animation progresses, and may adjust the layout of text if used on a fixed-size font string.

entries.name: DoesAuraHaveExpirationTime
entries.documentation: Returns true if an aura instance will expire after a certain amount of time.

entries.name: GetAuraApplicationDisplayCount
entries.documentation: Formats a string for displaying the number of applications an aura has present.

entries.name: GetAuraBaseDuration
entries.documentation: Returns the base duration of the given spell (or aura). Takes an optional spellID to use as the new duration if that cannot be derived from the aura, if that value isn't supplied the aura's spellID will be used

entries.name: GetAuraDispelTypeColor
entries.documentation: Queries the dispel type associated with an aura instance and remaps it to a color via a curve, with the dispel type ID used as the 'x' value.

entries.name: GetRefreshExtendedDuration
entries.documentation: Returns the client-predicted new duration of this aura if it were cast again right now. Takes an optional spellID to use as the new duration if that cannot be derived from the aura, if that value isn't supplied the aura's spellID will be used

entries.name: GetUnitAuraBySpellID
entries.documentation: Returns the first instance of an aura on a unit matching a given spell ID. Returns nil if no such aura is found. Additionally can return nil if querying a unit that is not visible (eg. party members on other maps).

entries.name: UnitAuraSortRule
entries.documentation: Applies no sorting to auras.

entries.name: PlayerIsSpellTarget
entries.documentation: If the unit is currently casting a spell, returns whether spell's target unit is the player. Returns false if the unit is not casting a spell or the spell has no target.

entries.name: UnitEmpoweredChannelDuration
entries.documentation: Returns a duration object that includes the duration of an empowered cast channel.

entries.name: UnitEmpoweredStageDurations
entries.documentation: Returns a vector of duration objects that measure the time spans for each individual stage in an empowered channel, with hold-at-max time included as the last element.

entries.name: UnitEmpoweredStagePercentages
entries.documentation: Returns a vector of percentages that describe how much of the total duration of an empowered channel is occupied by a stage.

entries.name: UnitGetDetailedHealPrediction
entries.documentation: If specified, a unit to evaluate as the 'healer' for incoming heal values. If nil, healer values will be zero.

entries.name: UnitHealthMissing
entries.documentation: Result of UnitHealthMax() - UnitHealth()

entries.name: UnitHealthPercent
entries.documentation: Returns percent of health remaining - can be scaled via a curve for display purposes

entries.name: UnitInOtherParty
entries.documentation: Checks whether this unit cannot see your party chat because it is in an instance group

entries.name: UnitIsMinion
entries.documentation: Returns whether the unit is considered a minion of a player, such as a pet, totem, or guardian.

entries.name: UnitPowerMissing
entries.documentation: Result of UnitPowerMax() - UnitPower()

entries.name: UnitPowerPercent
entries.documentation: Queries the percent of power remaining, optionally evaluating it against a supplied curve.

entries.name: UnitShouldDisplaySpellTargetName
entries.documentation: If the unit is currently casting a spell, returns whether the target's name should be displayed. Returns false if the unit is not casting a spell or the spell has no target.

entries.name: UnitSpellTargetClass
entries.documentation: If the unit is currently casting a spell, returns the class of the spell's target unit. Returns nil if the unit is not casting a spell or the spell has no target.

entries.name: UnitSpellTargetName
entries.documentation: If the unit is currently casting a spell, returns the name of the spell's target unit. Returns nil if the unit is not casting a spell or the spell has no target.

entries.name: UnitThreatLeadSituation
entries.documentation: Returns a threat state (0-3; representing none, yellow, orange, red) that indicates how far the provided unit is above the secondmost threat on the provided mob. If the unit is not first on threat, will always return red. Can return nil if the provided mob does not exist.

entries.name: UnitArenaCooldownsUpdate
entries.documentation: Only signaled when the active player is a commentator or spectator.

entries.name: EvaluateCurrentHealthPercent
entries.documentation: Calculates the percentage of current unit health and evaluates it against the supplied curve.

entries.name: EvaluateMissingHealthPercent
entries.documentation: Calculates the percentage of missing unit health and evaluates it against the supplied curve.

entries.name: GetCurrentHealth
entries.documentation: Returns the base amount of unit health.

entries.name: GetCurrentHealthPercent
entries.documentation: Returns the percentage of current unit health.

entries.name: GetDamageAbsorbClampMode
entries.documentation: Returns the configured damage absorb clamping mode.

entries.name: GetDamageAbsorbs
entries.documentation: Calculates damage absorb values and clamping according to the configured options.

entries.name: GetHealAbsorbClampMode
entries.documentation: Returns the configured heal absorb clamping mode.

entries.name: GetHealAbsorbMode
entries.documentation: Returns the configured heal absorb processing mode.

entries.name: GetHealAbsorbs
entries.documentation: Calculates heal absorb values and clamping according to the configured options.

entries.name: GetIncomingHealClampMode
entries.documentation: Returns the configured incoming heal clamping mode.

entries.name: GetIncomingHealOverflowPercent
entries.documentation: Returns the configured incoming heal maximum overflow percentage.

entries.name: GetIncomingHeals
entries.documentation: Calculates incoming heal values and clamping according to the configured options.

entries.name: GetMaximumDamageAbsorbs
entries.documentation: Returns the maximum clamping amount for damage absorbs.

entries.name: GetMaximumHealAbsorbs
entries.documentation: Returns the maximum clamping amount for heal absorbs.

entries.name: GetMaximumHealth
entries.documentation: Returns the base amount of maximum unit health.

entries.name: GetMaximumHealthMode
entries.documentation: Returns the configured maximum health mode.

entries.name: GetMaximumIncomingHeals
entries.documentation: Returns the maximum clamping amount for incoming heals.

entries.name: GetMissingHealth
entries.documentation: Returns the base amount of missing unit health.

entries.name: GetMissingHealthPercent
entries.documentation: Returns the percentage of missing unit health.

entries.name: GetPredictedValues
entries.documentation: Returns the raw total figures used for data calculations.

entries.name: GetTotalDamageAbsorbs
entries.documentation: Returns the base total amount of all applied damage absorb shields.

entries.name: GetTotalHealAbsorbs
entries.documentation: Returns the base total amount of all applied heal absorption effects.

entries.name: GetTotalIncomingHeals
entries.documentation: Returns the base total amount of all incoming heals.

entries.name: GetTotalIncomingHealsFromHealer
entries.documentation: Returns the base total amount of all incoming heals from the healer unit, if any.

entries.name: HasSecretValues
entries.documentation: Returns true if the object has been configured with any secret values.

entries.name: Reset
entries.documentation: Resets all stored state on the object.

entries.name: ResetPredictedValues
entries.documentation: Resets all stored healing values used for calculations.

entries.name: SetDamageAbsorbClampMode
entries.documentation: Changes the clamping mode used when calculating damage absorb amounts.

entries.name: SetHealAbsorbClampMode
entries.documentation: Changes the clamping mode used when calculating heal absorb amounts.

entries.name: SetHealAbsorbMode
entries.documentation: Changes the processing mode used when calculating both heal absorb and incoming heal amounts.

entries.name: SetIncomingHealClampMode
entries.documentation: Changes the clamping mode used when calculating incoming heal amounts.

entries.name: SetIncomingHealOverflowPercent
entries.documentation: Changes the maximum overflow percentage for incoming heals. Increasing this to a value over 1.0 will mean that incoming heals can extend beyond maximum health.

entries.name: SetMaximumHealthMode
entries.documentation: Changes the calculation mode for maximum health values used for clamping.

entries.name: SetPredictedValues
entries.documentation: Sets the healing values used for all calculations.

entries.name: SetToDefaults
entries.documentation: Resets all state on the object, and clears the secret values flag.

entries.name: UnitDamageAbsorbClampMode
entries.documentation: Clamp damage absorb values to the amount of missing health with incoming heals subtracted.

entries.name: UnitHealAbsorbClampMode
entries.documentation: Clamp heal absorb values to the amount of current health.

entries.name: UnitHealAbsorbMode
entries.documentation: Reduce heal absorb values by incoming heals, and vice versa, clamping to zero where necessary.

entries.name: UnitIncomingHealClampMode
entries.documentation: Clamp incoming heal values to the amount of missing health with overflow applied.

entries.name: UnitMaximumHealthMode
entries.documentation: Use maximum unit health as-is without adjustments.

entries.name: UnitDamageAbsorbInfo
entries.documentation: Amount of applied damage absorb affects with potential reductions from clamping included.

entries.name: UnitHealAbsorbInfo
entries.documentation: Amount of applied heal absorb affects with potential reductions from incoming heals and clamping included.

entries.name: UnitIncomingHealInfo
entries.documentation: Amount of incoming heals across all units with potential reductions from heal absorb effects included.

entries.name: AreClassRolesSoftSuggestions
entries.documentation: If true, UnitGetAvailableRoles results should be treated as suggested role, not hard limits on what role the current player can display as.

entries.name: MarkChannelsDiscovered
entries.documentation: Once the UI has enumerated all channels, use this to reset the channel discovery state, it will be updated again if appropriate

entries.name: SetMemberVolume
entries.documentation: Adjusts member volume across all channels

entries.name: ShouldDiscoverChannels
entries.documentation: Use this while loading to determine if the UI should attempt to rediscover the previously joined/active voice channels

entries.name: SpeakText
entries.documentation: SpeakText also supports XML TTS tags on Windows including bookmarks - see SAPI XML TTS Tutorial in Microsoft's online documentation for more information.
